title: kin5ax kinematic chain
description: A 5C milling machine: two branches from a common base, the tool branch ending at the nose of the tool spindle, the workpiece branch ending at the table. Written and read by kin5ax (CChainJsonWriter, CChainJsonReader).

unit.description: The unit of every length in the file. Required: a file that does not say is refused, since its numbers are not lengths until it does. The models shipped with kin5ax are metres; FreeCAD works in millimetres.

name.description: Name of the model, e.g. "BC tilt-rotary table".

machine.description: Brand and model of the real machine, e.g. "SHW UniSpeed 3500".

tool_spindle_nose.description: End of the tool branch: the nose of the tool spindle. Its origin is on the spindle axis where that axis meets the convex envelope of the spindle, which is the centre of the entrance to the taper, and its OZ runs along the spindle axis.

table.description: End of the workpiece branch: the table of the machine, where a workpiece holder is bolted.

links.description: Joints from the base outwards; may be empty.

type.description: rotary turns about the local OZ, linear slides along it.

terminal.description: End of a branch: a constant transformation with collision solids, not a joint. The table also carries the workpiece holder the machine usually has.

workpiece_holder.description: What stands on the table and holds the part: a vice, a chuck, a tombstone, a plate. The frame says where the workpiece sits, read from the table, and the boxes are what the tool must not run into. A default for a host to offer; NO_HOLDER is the part bolted to the table itself and CUSTOM_HOLDER the one a host fills in.

model.description: The designation: X_VICE, Y_VICE, THREE_JAW_CHUCK, FOUR_JAW_CHUCK, TOMBSTONE, FIXTURE_PLATE, NO_HOLDER, CUSTOM_HOLDER, or anything a workshop calls its own. The library never reads it.

translation.description: Where the workpiece sits, read from the table; the origin when left out.

rotation.description: How its frame is turned, for a holder that does not hold the part flat on top of itself, such as a tombstone.

tool_terminal.description: End of the tool branch: the nose of the tool spindle, with the tool holder of the machine and collision solids.

tool.description: The tool the machine usually holds, sticking out of the holder. A default for whoever puts something in the spindle: it takes no part in the kinematics, which work from the tool offset given at run time.

type.description: ball_end is a ball of the corner radius at the tip, cylinder a flat end, toroidal a flat end with the bottom edge rounded by the corner radius.

radius.description: The radius of the tool: half the cutting diameter.

corner_radius.description: The rounding of the bottom edge, which for a ball nose tool is the ball itself. Left out it is the radius for a ball_end and zero for the other two.

cutting_height.description: How far the cutting part reaches up from the tip.

length.description: The whole length that sticks out of the holder, cutting part included. What is gripped inside the holder is not described.

reference_point.description: Where the point a cutter location programs lies on the tool; the tip when left out. ball_centre is for a ball nose tool only.

reference_height.description: For a custom reference point: how far it sits above the tip, measured towards the spindle. Required then, meaningless otherwise.

tool_holder.description: The holder that hangs from the nose of the tool spindle, with the tool sticking out of it: up to three cylinders along the OZ of the nose, given from the nose downwards. A radius of zero is a cylinder without a body, a distance only. Give either sections or a single length and radius, not both. A holder with no cylinder at all is the tool clamped straight into the spindle, whose designation is NO_HOLDER.

model.description: The designation on the holder, free text: BT40 ER32, HSK63A SF12, or NO_HOLDER for none. The library never reads it; it is carried so that a host can match it against the holders it has of its own.

sections.description: The cylinders of the holder, from the nose downwards: the taper, whatever it narrows to, the nose the tool comes out of.

rotation.description: Constant rotation of the segment, applied before its translation.

axis.description: Need not be a unit vector; may be zero only when angle_deg is zero.

limits.description: Joint range; absent means unconstrained. Degrees for a rotary link, length units for a linear one. min must not be above max.

boxes.description: Collision solids that are all boxes, in the frame after the constant transformation of the segment. The shorthand for the common case; solids is the general list and a segment may carry both.

solids.description: Collision solids of any kind, in the frame after the constant transformation of the segment: a box, a piece of a cylinder or a piece of a sphere. Every entry names its type. A machine is never allowed a pose that breaks something, but a wedge or a dome may be refused one it could have had: the pieces are tested as the shapes they were cut from (KnownBugs #72).

oneOf.description: The same box as an entry of the boxes array.
A piece of a cylinder: the axis runs along one axis of the frame, through axis_point, from base to top as coordinates along that axis, and the two angles make a wedge of it.

axis.description: Which axis of the frame the cylinder runs along.

axis_point.description: A point the axis passes through; the origin when left out. Only its two coordinates across the axis matter.

base.description: The coordinate of the lower end along the axis, read off the frame.

min_angle_deg.description: The wedge, measured about the axis from the first axis across it towards the second: for a z cylinder from +x towards +y. The whole turn when left out.

oneOf.description: A piece of a sphere: the whole sphere, or what two planes across one axis leave of it - a dome or a band.

centre.description: The centre; the origin when left out.

axis.description: Which axis the two cuts are perpendicular to. A sphere that is cut says it.

min.description: The lower cut, as a coordinate along that axis measured FROM THE CENTRE: 0 .. radius is a half sphere.
